abilities.name: Attack
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: Convention: every class ships a free rank-1 Attack.

abilities.name: Unmake
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Unearthed Pools reduces the cast time of Unmake'; Infinite's rotation uses it as a filler and Artificer transforms it into Artificer's Wand. Mage's Frostbolt curve - the class's cheap, always-available nuke.

abilities.name: Wand of Time
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: Wand of Time is a class ability that Infinite transforms into Timerend and Artificer uses as its fragment generator. ranged_damage, not spell_damage - it is a wand swing, and Artificer's Wand Expert ('increases your ranged attack power by 100% of your Spirit') only has something to scale if the engine's ranged_attack_power is what drives it.

abilities.name: Reverse Wound
abilities.description: Heals an ally.
abilities._source: CoA says in all three spec pages that Reverse Wound is 'your only real self-heal'. Priest's Heal curve.

abilities.name: Decomposition
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to the target over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Eternal increases the duration of your Accelerated Recovery and Decomposition'. Infinite seeds it for proc uptime, Artificer turns it into a Distortion spell.

abilities.name: Accelerated Recovery
abilities.description: Their body heals at the pace it would have taken a month to manage.
abilities._source: CoA class tree ability, and half of Time's core loop.

abilities.name: Chronostasis
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Haste -25 for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Temporal Dissonance - Chronostasis now slows your target's movement speed by an additional -10%'. Haste is the engine's real slow (turn_meter.py reads it off status effects for turn order), so a slow is a haste debuff.

abilities.name: Roll Back
abilities.description: Return your ally to the version of themselves from a few seconds ago.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Roll Back to cleanse harmful effects'. A broad cleanse, so the full dispel_type tuple rather than one school.

abilities.name: Discordance
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to up to 3 targets.
abilities._source: CoA: Discordance is the shared cleave - Infinite's Timelost Power widens it, Artificer's Clocked In and Caverns of Time bank fragments off it.

abilities.name: Waves of Time
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to up to 4 targets.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Blast enemies in a frontal cone with time fractals, knocking them back slightly. The knockback repeats 1 additional time after 2 sec.' There is no knockback or displacement in a turn engine, so this is the damage half only.

abilities.name: Time Out!
abilities.description: Damage taken -30%, Mp5 +20 for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree, and Time's personal emergency layer: 'Time Out! and your absorb stack are the emergency layer'. The channelled mana regen is the mp5 half.

abilities.name: Clasp of Infinity
abilities.description: Applies to up to 3 targets: Haste -40 for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Conjure a magical binding upon an enemy that bounces to nearby enemies, rooting them in place for 4 seconds.' The engine has one crowd-control flag, is_stun, and no root - a bouncing root that still lets the target act is a heavy slow here, not a stun.

abilities.name: Babify
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns the target for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Instantly transform all enemies into a baby, preventing them from acting ... damage dealt will interrupt this effect.' is_stun is the engine's incapacitate; the break-on-damage half has no hook, so it runs the full two turns.

abilities.name: Fortify Timeline
abilities.description: Heals your party.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'Fortify the current timeline, instantly healing all allies and extending the duration of Accelerated Recovery on them by 5 sec.' The extension half needs a cast to reach into an existing status effect's clock, which nothing supports, so this is the instant group heal only.

abilities.name: Timeguard
abilities.description: Grants an ally: Damage taken -30% for 3 turns, absorbing damage.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'causing the next 3 instances of direct damage that would reduce the target below 35% health to deal 40% less damage'. No health-gated charge system exists, so it is a flat cut plus a real absorb for three turns.

abilities.name: Hasten
abilities.description: Grants an ally: Haste +15 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree, referenced by The Bieko Effect, Maker of Realities and Unmaker of Realities; Artificer calls it 'Hasten to hand one ally haste and movement speed'.

abilities.name: Temporal Focus
abilities.description: Immune to crowd control for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'removing and becoming immune to banish, silence, and interrupt effects for 10 seconds'. cc_immune is the engine's real immunity flag (checked in StatusEffectMixin.apply_status_effect).

abilities.name: Temporal Anomaly
abilities.description: Strengthens you for 2 turns, absorbing damage.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: 'causing 50% of the damage taken to be absorbed and converted into healing at the end of the duration'. An absorb shield is the absorb half; there is no deferred release, so the shield simply holds.

abilities.name: Infinite Shield
abilities.description: Strengthens an ally for 4 turns, absorbing damage.
abilities._source: CoA class tree: '10 charges ... Each time they take damage, they will be healed and lose 1 charge.' Charges do not exist; a four-turn absorb is the same trade.

abilities.name: Gravity Bomb
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to up to 5 targets over time for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA class tree tier 2: 'After 6 seconds they explode for Chromatic Damage in a 10 yds radius. Directly before the explosion occurs, all enemies within 15 yds are teleported to the initial target.' The delay and the teleport-in have no hooks; a two-turn AoE DoT is the detonation.

abilities.name: Chromatic Shard
abilities.description: A shard of raw disorder. There is nothing in it to resist.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Your core spender is Chromatic Shard, a chaos bolt that pierces immunities and resistances.' No ability flag bypasses resistance - Monster.take_damage reduces by school resistance unconditionally - but the ATTACKER's spell_penetration is subtracted there, which is why the Time Means Nothing talent grants it instead of a vulnerability debuff. No cooldown: CoA has it getting FASTER as Anomaly Spikes land ('reduces the cast time of this ability by 10%, stacking 10 times') and the rotation says to 'dump Chromatic Shard' through the burst window, so Mana is what rations it, not a timer. It is the class's second spammable nuke - the shared kit otherwise has only Unmake, and a cloth caster with one filler loses fights a Mage with Fireball and Frostbolt wins.
abilities._level_note: Rank 1 moved from level 10 to 6, 29 Oct 2026. Kyle's call on the early-game finding: the class was soft at levels 5-20 and fine from 30, and the cause was how FEW damage buttons it had early rather than how hard they hit. Values unchanged at every rank, so nothing moves at 60.

abilities.name: Melt Reality
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to the target over time for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Melt the target's reality, dealing Chromatic Damage every 3 sec for 30 seconds. While active, periodic damage dealt to the target is replicated for 20% of the value to all enemies near them.' The replication lives on the Shifting Chaos and Infinite Keeper talents, which use the engine's splash_damage proc payload.

abilities.name: Timerend
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to the target over time for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Transforms your Wand of Time into Timerend. Rend the fabric of time, dealing Chromatic Damage over 6 seconds.' Authored as its own spell rather than a transform - nothing in the engine replaces one ability with another.

abilities.name: Anomaly Spike
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Periodic damage dealt now has a chance to launch an Anomaly Spike at your target.' A real second spell, fired free by the Anomaly Spikes talent's cast_ability proc, which is why it exists as an ability at all.

abilities.name: Destabilize Time
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Haste -20, Attack Power -40 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Reduces enemy casting speed by -10% for 20 seconds, increasing by -10% every time they cast.' The escalation needs an on-enemy-cast hook; a flat slow plus an attack-power cut is the static version. Monsters read haste and attack_power off status effects and nothing else, so those are the two levers that work on them.

abilities.name: Slipstream
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns the target for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Target an enemy and slip them into a pocket dimension for 5 seconds, banishing them and making them immune to damage.' The damage immunity is not expressible, so this is a two-turn incapacitate - which is the part the rotation actually uses it for ('Use Slipstream to remove a dangerous add from the fight').

abilities.name: Infinite Horizon
abilities.description: Grants your party: Damage dealt +5% for 4 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Increases the all damage dealt by party and raid members by 3%', and 'Infinite Horizon giving the group a flat damage buff is its one support note'. damage_dealt_pct is the engine's buff-granted damage key (read in Ability._damage_multiplier) and takes percentage POINTS, unlike the talent keys.

abilities.name: Incarnation of Chaos
abilities.description: Damage dealt +15%, Haste +10 for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Transform into an Incarnate of Chaos, instantly resetting the cooldown of Chromatic Shard and causing your next cast to not incur a cooldown. In addition, your damage dealt is increased by 15% for 15 seconds.' Only the damage window is on the ability - the resets live on the Infinite Power and Aeon Rend talents, which have a real reset_cooldown proc payload to use.

abilities.name: Epoch
abilities.description: Heals an ally.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Core loop is Epoch (a heal that builds Sands of Time stacks) and Accelerated Recovery (a HoT).' Sands of Time cannot be a resource (see module docstring), so the stack payoff is the Carbon Dating and Epic Recovery talents raising Epoch's own healing.

abilities.name: Correct the Mistake
abilities.description: Heals your party.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Retell the fate of party members within 30 yds, healing them.' One of Time's two party-wide tools.

abilities.name: Ripple
abilities.description: Heals your party.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Channel for up to 5 seconds ... allies within 40 yds are healed based on the duration of the channel. While channeling, you are immune to stun effects.' There is no channel, so it resolves in one turn at full value and the stun immunity is dropped - Temporal Focus is where the class keeps that.

abilities.name: Aeon of Resilience
abilities.description: Haste +12, Mp5 +12 for 60 turns.
abilities._source: CoA's level-10 free passive: 'Reduces Epoch's cast time by -25% and its mana cost by -10%, and healing done by it now reduces the target's damage taken.' Frontier has no free passives, so the first Aeon is learned from level and the other three are talents. All four share exclusive_group, which is the engine's real one-at-a-time mechanic and exactly CoA's 'four Aeons that share a cooldown'. duration 60 with buff_scope raid is the loadout pattern Tinker's Rounds already use for a stance that should survive between fights.

abilities.name: Aeon of Protection
abilities.description: Slower, heavier, and it leaves something behind to take the next hit.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Increases Epoch's cast time by 15%, healing done by 15%, and causes it to apply a damage absorption shield equal to 30% of the amount healed.' A cast buff cannot make ANOTHER spell apply a shield, so the absorb half is the Orderly Protector talent's shield_pct proc and this is the healing and mitigation half.

abilities.name: Aeon of Renewal
abilities.description: Healing Done Pct +18%, Haste -6 for 60 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Reduces Epoch's healing by -30%, but causes it to heal for an additional 50% of the amount healed over 3 seconds.' Trading burst for total output is the shape; the engine cannot split one heal into a direct part and a trailing HoT, so it is more healing at a slower pace.

abilities.name: Aeon of Oblivion
abilities.description: Spell crit chance +12, Healing Done Pct +10% for 60 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Increases Epoch's mana cost by 30%, critical strike chance by 10%, and healing done by 15%. In addition, healing with Epoch now increases the target's damage dealt by 3%.' The recipient buff needs a heal to apply a buff to its target, which nothing supports.

abilities.name: Fabric of Time
abilities.description: Heals an ally.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Alter the fabric of time, healing an ally. Your next Aeon used within 8 seconds will trigger with no cooldown or cost.' The free-Aeon rider is not expressible from a heal; the Orderly Protector talent carries the rest of this node's identity.

abilities.name: Buy Time
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns up to 4 targets for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Put all enemies and allies in an 8 yd radius into a stasis, banishing them for 6 seconds, making them invulnerable to all effects but unable to move.' The friendly-fire half (it freezes allies too) and the invulnerability are not expressible, so this is an AoE incapacitate on enemies - the use CoA's own rotation gives it ('freeze the extra mobs with Buy Time so they're locked out while you kill the first').

abilities.name: Continuum Restoration
abilities.description: You restore the local continuum, and nothing anyone did to it stays done.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Restore the continuum at target location for all allies and enemies, removing all beneficial magic effects from enemies and harmful magic effects from allies. This dispel is potent enough to remove magic effects that are normally undispellable.' A dispel reads one target, so the enemy-purge half is gone; the two-count is the 'potent' half.

abilities.name: Displacement
abilities.description: Removes 1 magic effect from an ally.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Displaces a party or raid member and pulls them to you, dispelling root and snare effects from them.' There are no root or snare dispel categories (DispelType is magic/curse/poison/disease), and no repositioning, so this is the cleanse.

abilities.name: Artificer's Wand
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source:
29 Oct 2026, Kyle: "Fix up chrono." Artificer's Wand is the spec's FILLER and main Echo Fragment generator per reference/coa_sidekick/SPEC_chronomancer__artificer.txt ("Fill with Artificer's Wand to bank Echo Fragments", "Artificer's Wand and auto-wand attacks keep damage flowing while you kite") - and it was never the best button at ANY level. It peaked at 115 a turn at 54 while Chromatic Shard reached 206 and Shatter Echo 230, so it sat fourth in its own kit from level 12 to 60 and no sane rotation ever pressed it.

That is what made the whole spec read as broken. Artificer's talents amplify artificers_wand, wand_of_time, discordance and shatter_echo; Wand Expert converts Spirit into ranged attack power and Artificer's Empowerment raises that Spirit, so the sidekick's "almost the entire kit scales off one stat" is real and implemented. But the rotation cast Chromatic Shard instead - a GENERIC Chronomancer spell all three specs share and no Artificer talent touches - so 56 talent points amplified abilities the spec never used. Measured, Chromatic Shard landed 1.22x its listed value where Mage's Fireball lands 2.04x, and chronomancer_artificer won 50% at level 20 against chronomancer_infinite's 81% on the same gear.

So the fix is the wand, not the tree: the tree was right and the numbers made its intended playstyle unplayable. Raised to parity with Chromatic Shard's curve, with costs kept well below it (210 for 104 against 206 for 158, so ~1.55x the damage per mana) because a no-cooldown filler should be the efficient button. Artificer's own talents, Singularity Core's +10% damage and the Spirit-to-ranged-AP conversion then push it clearly ahead, which is the design.

Safe to buff in isolation: artificers_wand, crystal_cannon and shatter_echo all carry requires_talent, so they exist only for Artificer. Chromatic Shard is untouched, so Infinite and Time are unaffected.

abilities.name: Crystal Cannon
abilities.description: Deals damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Casting Discordance now unleashes the Crystal Cannon, launching 2 quick lesser Wand attacks at the enemy over 1 seconds, scaling with Spirit.' Fired free by the Crystal Cannon talent's cast_ability proc.

abilities.name: Shatter Echo
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to the target.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Distortion Spell. Launch a distorted echo from your wand at an enemy ... Damage increased by 40% for each Echo Fragment consumed.' Fragments are not a resource, so the spend is a cooldown and the Hyperwand and Pulse Driver talents are the fragment scaling.

abilities.name: Singularity Core
abilities.description: Damage dealt +10%, Physical crit chance +6 for 60 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Continuum Spell. Empower your Wand attacks to deal an additional 50% Ranged Weapon Damage ... Can only have 1 Continuum spell active at a time.' The one-at-a-time rule is exclusive_group, the same mechanic the Aeons use. The per-fragment duration extension is not expressible.

abilities.name: Flux Emitter
abilities.description: Damage dealt +6%, Haste +8 for 60 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Continuum Spell. Empower Wand attacks to affect up to 2 additional nearby enemies ... Affected attacks deal less damage per additional enemy hit.' A buff cannot change another ability's target count, so the cleave lives on Splitting Time's aoe_damage and this is the throughput half - weaker per hit than Singularity Core, matching the trade CoA describes.

abilities.name: Paradox Cannon
abilities.description: Restores mana to you.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Continuum Spell. Generate 1 Echo Fragment every 3 sec for 5 seconds, plus an additional 5 sec per Echo Fragment consumed.' A pure generator with nothing to generate - Echo Fragments are not a resource - so it banks the thing the rotation actually runs out of, and 'bank ahead with Paradox Cannon between pulls' still reads true. Deliberately NOT in the Continuum exclusive_group: restore_resource applies no status effect, so it has nothing to be exclusive with.

abilities.name: Aether Compression
abilities.description: Makes your next cast instant.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Continuum Spell. Artificer's Wand and Reverse Wound can be cast while moving for 5 seconds.' Nothing moves in this engine, so the closest honest version of 'your cast stops costing you anything' is the instant-cast enabler. Also outside the Continuum exclusive_group, because enable_instant_cast does not apply a status effect that a group could exclude.

abilities.name: Arc Collision
abilities.description: Deals Arcane damage to up to 3 targets over time for 3 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Distortion Spell. Create a timestorm around an enemy that causes them and up to 2 nearby enemies to take Arcane damage, repeating over 4 seconds.' CoA is blunt that it is 'a capped, undertuned timestorm rather than a pack nuke - don't build around it', so it is capped at 3 and carries no talent support.

abilities.name: Unstable Chronoglass
abilities.description: Applies to the target: Hit Chance Spell -60 for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Place an Unstable Chronoglass at target location that will redirect the next 3 offensive enemy spell casts onto itself.' Redirection needs a placed object that can be targeted, and the pet system's templates all carry their own display_name, so summoning one would put 'Sentry Turret' on screen. Implemented instead as the outcome - the enemy's spells stop landing - the same way mage_counterspell stands in for a real interrupt.

abilities.name: Collapse
abilities.description: Interrupts and stuns the target for 2 turns.
abilities._source: CoA: 'Collapse sets up a delayed stun'. The delay has no hook; the stun is real.
